name: Lorah
source:
Mysterious character sided with the Enorean empire who can fight back against dragonkins. Extremely fast and brave, she prefers take her opponents as prisioners instead of killing them, since they are "more valuable alive than dead".
[spoiler]When Brunarian reinforcements arrived, she just vanished in a black smoke, taking with her one of Teelon eyes and leaving the rest of the soldiers at their luck.[/spoiler]
